segments.contextAfter: To add the new ruler marker to `aRulerView`, use either of NSRulerView’s [`addMarker(_:)`](nsrulerview/addmarker(_:).md) or [`trackMarker(_:withMouseEvent:)`](nsrulerview/trackmarker(_:withmouseevent:).md) methods. [`addMarker(_:)`](nsrulerview/addmarker(_:).md) immediately puts the marker on the ruler, while [`trackMarker(_:withMouseEvent:)`](nsrulerview/trackmarker(_:withmouseevent:).md) allows the client view to intercede in the addition and placement of the marker.
